description: This file contains the server-side logic for the 'EditMCQ' page of an online examination system. It handles UI events such as course selection, navigation between pages, and session management, primarily related to editing multiple-choice questions for different courses and semesters.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Partial class representing the server-side code for the EditMCQ ASP.NET page, derived from System.Web.UI.Page.
